body.name: lonekrav-advisor
body.description: Reads a job ad, the applicant's background and the offer, and writes an honest-fit memo: every plausible SSYK 2012 code with its Swedish work-permit salary consequences, from Lönekrav's own data. It uses a third-party language model (via OpenRouter), which receives the ad, background and offer you send.

skills.name: Honest-fit occupation and salary memo
skills.description: Send one data part {ad, background?, offer?} (offer: monthly_salary_sek, fte_percent, application_type, filed_on, ...) or the ad as text. Streams progress, a ui_sync artifact per tool result, and a markdown memo.
examples: A backend developer ad with an offer of a monthly salary for a first permit
